metaDescription: Six larger toaster ovens at or below $100 compared on convection, air fry, pan fit and door design, for families who want a real second oven.
expertTake: The BLACK+DECKER 6-slice air fry oven is the best pick because it adds convection air frying to a pizza-sized chamber. The Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 6 slice is the value pick for people who want the roll-top door without air fry. Anyone who cooks only toast and bagels should skip this tier and buy a basic oven for less.
introParagraphs: Once the budget grows, a toaster oven stops being a toast box and becomes a small second oven. The extra money buys a larger chamber, a convection fan that moves hot air around the food, and in many cases an air fry mode with a perforated basket.

Those features change what you can cook: a full pizza, a family casserole pan, or a tray of wings that browns on both sides. Doors, racks and controls matter more than they did at the entry level. Prices move, and every oven below was at or under $100 on its listing when this guide was updated.

products.description:
This BLACK+DECKER combines a six slice chamber that takes a 12 inch pizza with five functions: air fry, bake, broil, toast and keep warm. The air fry setting runs a convection fan with a perforated basket, which crisps food using hot air rather than oil. The maker claims up to 75 percent less fat than deep frying, which is a typical figure for the method.

It is the widest all-round package in the lineup. Next to the Hamilton Beach 4 slice combo it offers a bigger chamber, and next to the Easy Reach 6 slice air fry model it uses a conventional front door instead of a roll-top. The EvenToast feature targets the uneven browning that cheap ovens show.

An air fry basket holds a modest batch, so wings for a crowd take two rounds. Wash the basket and tray by hand to preserve any nonstick coating. Clear a spot with space above for hot exhaust. It is the best choice for a family that wants one appliance to do toast, pizza and crispy fries.
products.bestFor: Families that want air frying and pizza in one countertop oven.
pros: Five functions including air fry and keep warm
Six slice chamber fits a 12 inch pizza
EvenToast aims at consistent browning
Convection fan speeds up cooking
cons: Air fry basket batches are modest in size
Conventional door swings down and uses counter depth

products.name: Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 6 Slice Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.description:
The Easy Reach air fryer combo keeps the brand's signature roll-top door. When opened, the glass slides up and out of the way so you can reach food and the counter without a hot door in your forearm. It adds a Sure-Crisp convection function for air frying.

The door design is the main reason to choose it over the BLACK+DECKER 6-slice oven. A drop-down door sits over the counter and can catch splatter, while a roll-top stays clear. Against the plain Easy Reach 6 slice, it adds the convection fan and an air fry mode for a modest extra.

The roll-top has a mechanism that must stay clean, so wipe the tracks. The glass gets hot, so use oven mitts. It suits cooks with limited counter depth or anyone who has burned an arm on a drop-down door.
products.bestFor: Cooks who want air fry plus a door that does not block the counter.
pros: Roll-top door clears the counter and the food
Sure-Crisp convection air fry function
Six slice interior suits family meals
Bake, broil and toast included
cons: Roll-top door mechanism needs periodic cleaning
Glass surface gets hot while cooking

products.name: Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 6 Slice Convection Toaster Oven
products.description:
This model offers four ways to cook, convection, bake, broil and toast, on two rack positions. A 30 minute timer comes with a Stay On setting, so long bakes are not limited. A bake pan and rack ship with the oven.

It is the convection oven without the air fry basket, which is why it sits below the air fryer combo. Convection circulates air and cuts cook time compared with a plain bake. Next to the BLACK+DECKER TO3250 extra wide oven, it is narrower but has the Easy Reach roll-top door.

The interior is large enough for a pizza or a casserole. Clean the roll-top tracks and the crumb tray on a schedule. It is a good fit for a household that wants even baking and a friendly door without paying for air fry hardware.
products.bestFor: Even baking with a roll-top door and no air fry extras.
pros: Convection cooks faster and more evenly than plain bake
Two rack positions give layout options
Stay On timer removes the 30 minute limit
Bake pan and rack in the box
cons: No air fry basket or mode

products.description:
This is the widest oven in the guide, fitting most standard 9 by 13 inch pans, which means you can use pans you already own. A convection fan circulates warm air for fast, even baking, and the oven ships with a bake pan, broil rack and toasting rack.

It solves the biggest complaint about small ovens, that a casserole or sheet of cookies will not fit. Next to the Hamilton Beach Easy Reach models it uses a conventional door and has no air fry mode. The maker notes that oven temperatures run lower than the dial because of advanced heating elements, so check doneness rather than trusting the setting.

Its footprint is large, so measure the counter. The size and the pans make it a real second oven for holidays. Wash the racks by hand and keep the crumb tray clear.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Easy Reach 6 Slice Toaster Oven
products.description:
The plain Easy Reach is a bake, broil and toast oven with the roll-top door. The interior fits a 9 by 11 inch pan, six slices of bread or a 12 inch pizza. Spills stay out of the way of the door because the glass rolls up and back.

It skips the convection fan, so it is the simplest oven here and the cheapest way into the Easy Reach door. Against the convection version it bakes less evenly and more slowly. Compared with the Hamilton Beach air fryer models, it has fewer parts to fail.

The basic thermostat is the part to watch, so use an oven thermometer. Wipe tracks and the tray after use. It is the pick for someone who wants a solid six slice oven and the roll-top convenience at the lowest cost in this guide.
products.bestFor: A simple six slice oven with the Easy Reach door.
pros: Roll-top door keeps the counter and food reachable
Fits a 9 by 11 inch pan or a 12 inch pizza
Simple bake, broil and toast controls
Fewer parts to fail than combo models
cons: No convection fan, so baking is slower and less even

products.name: Hamilton Beach 4 Slice Air Fryer Toaster Oven
products.description:
This is the smallest air fryer oven in the lineup, with four slice capacity, a 30 minute timer and four cooking options. Powerful air circulation browns food with little oil. It is meant for smaller kitchens that still want a crisping mode.

It costs less space than the BLACK+DECKER 6-slice air fry model and fits a smaller pizza, so it suits one or two people. Compared with the Easy Reach combo it uses a standard door but keeps the same brand support. The compact chamber heats quickly.

Wash the air fry basket by hand. Because the chamber is small, crowding food blocks airflow and defeats the crisping. It is a smart choice for couples and small kitchens that like air fried snacks.
products.bestFor: Couples and small kitchens that want an air fry mode in a compact oven.
pros: Air fry, bake, broil and toast in a compact body
Powerful circulation crisps food with little oil
30 minute timer suits quick meals
Smaller footprint than six slice combos
cons: Four slice interior limits pizza and pan size
Crowding the chamber reduces air fry results

buyingCriteria.explanation: Convection moves hot air around the food, cutting time and evening browning. An air fry mode adds a perforated basket and a faster fan. The Hamilton Beach Easy Reach convection oven has convection only, the BLACK+DECKER 6-slice adds air fry.

The BLACK+DECKER TO3250 takes most 9 by 13 pans, while the Easy Reach 6 slice takes a 9 by 11. Six slice ovens fit a 12 inch pizza. Check the height of the chamber under the top elements before ordering a casserole dish.
A drop-down door hangs over the counter and can catch spills. The Easy Reach roll-top glass slides up and back so you can reach food easily. The tradeoff is a mechanism to keep clean.
The Easy Reach convection oven has a 30 minute timer with Stay On for longer jobs. The Hamilton Beach 4 slice combo is limited to 30 minutes. If you roast or bake bread, check the timer type first.
BLACK+DECKER notes that oven temperatures can run below the set point. Cheap thermostats cycle widely, so place an oven thermometer inside. Adjust the dial to match.
The extra wide BLACK+DECKER and the six slice models need real counter room and clearance from cabinets. Heat vents upward and backward. Measure before you buy.

howWeEvaluated.title: Cooking method
howWeEvaluated.description: We separated plain bake ovens from convection and air fry models. The plain Easy Reach represents the first group, the TO3250 the second and the BLACK+DECKER 6-slice the third. Method affects speed and evenness.

howWeEvaluated.title: Space and fit
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared interior dimensions through the pans and pizzas they take. The TO3250 handles 9 by 13 pans, the Easy Reach 9 by 11. The 4 slice combo was marked down for pan fit.

howWeEvaluated.title: Door and handling
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared the roll-top Easy Reach door with the drop-down doors on the BLACK+DECKER models. Doors that stay clear of the counter scored higher for safety. Glass heat was noted.

howWeEvaluated.title: Controls
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at timers, Stay On and temperature range. The Stay On setting on the Easy Reach convection oven helps longer bakes. A 30 minute limit was marked down for roasting.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We weighed recurring owner themes such as thermostat drift and cleaning difficulty, without quoting any rating number. The $100 cap was applied against live listing position.

cards.label: Air fry combo
cards.text: Adds a basket and a faster fan for crisp results. The BLACK+DECKER 6-Slice, Easy Reach Air Fryer and 4 Slice combo offer it.

cards.label: Convection only
cards.text: Faster, even baking without a basket. The Easy Reach Convection and TO3250 do this.

howToChoose.note: Choose air fry if you cook wings and fries, and convection only if you mostly bake.

Thermostats drift. A cheap oven thermometer tells you how much.

faq.q: Is an air fry toaster oven better than a basket air fryer?
faq.a: It is more versatile since it also bakes, broils and toasts, though the batch size is smaller than a large basket unit. For a single appliance, the oven wins.

faq.q: How much should a good toaster oven cost?
faq.a: This guide uses a $100 cap, with picks across the range. Prices move, so the cap reflects listing prices when the guide was updated.

faq.q: How long do these ovens last?
faq.a: Heating elements last for years. Door mechanisms and thermostats are the common wear points.

faq.q: Why do my oven temperatures seem off?
faq.a: Budget thermostats drift. Use an oven thermometer to find the offset.
